skill.name: Event Timeline Waterfall Navigation
skill.description: Interact with a time-ordered waterfall visualization of LLM calls, action events, tool calls, and errors. Select individual events to view detailed prompt, completion, and metadata for inspection and debugging.
skill.skill_body:
On the waterfall visualization, locate the event of interest in the time-ordered list on the left. Click or select the event. The right-side panel will display exact prompt, completion, timestamps, and metadata for that event. Use this to inspect error messages, review exact LLM prompts and completions, or examine tool call details.

## Objective

inspect_individual_event_details
## Applicable Signals

- Session waterfall is displayed
- User has a specific LLM call, action event, tool call, or error to investigate

## Contraindications

- User is looking for aggregate statistics across events
- User is seeking cross-session patterns or comparisons
- User needs high-level session overview rather than event-level detail

## Workflow Steps

- Locate the waterfall visualization with time-ordered events on the left panel
- Identify the target event (LLM call, action event, tool call, or error) in the timeline
- Click or select the event
- Observe the right-side panel populate with event details

## Constraints

- Event must exist in the waterfall visualization
- Session must have been previously recorded
- Event selection requires interactive UI interaction

## Output Contract

- Right-side panel displays exact prompt, completion, timestamps, and metadata for the selected event. Output includes full event context automatically recorded by the system.
